files.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: Web_App
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: website
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: nginx
          imagePullPolicy: always
          port:
            - containerPort: 80
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 512mb
              cpu: "2"
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
          env:
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              value: hunter2
            - name: DEBUG
              value: yes
          securityContext:
            privileged: true
---
apiVersion: extensions/v1beta1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  rules:
    - host: example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            backend:
              serviceName: web
              servicePort: 80
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: batch/v1beta1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: cleanup
spec:
  schedule: "0 3 * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
            - name: c
              image: busybox:1.36
---
apiVersion: policy/v1beta1
kind: PodSecurityPolicy
metadata:
  name: restricted
spec: {}
